itemDisplayName: Flexible hub and spoke landing zone
summary: Deploys a modular hub and spoke Azure landing zone with optional firewall, Bastion, VPN gateway, NAT gateway and monitoring.
description: This subscription level template deploys a flexible Azure landing zone using a hub and spoke network topology. It creates a connectivity resource group containing the hub virtual network, plus production and non-production spoke virtual networks with frontend, application, database, management and private endpoint subnets, each protected by its own network security group. Hub to spoke and spoke to hub peerings are configured automatically, and gateway transit is enabled only when a VPN gateway is deployed. Every costly component is disabled by default so the template deploys as a minimal, low cost foundation and can be expanded later: Azure Firewall, Azure Bastion, VPN Gateway, NAT Gateway and Log Analytics are each behind an individual feature flag. Additional spokes can be added through the spokeConfigurations parameter without redesigning the landing zone, making the sample suitable for proofs of concept, migration landing zones and phased enterprise adoption.
